lens: Quality and empathy for every unhappy path and edge state (permission denied, offline, speech model not downloaded, transcription failed or empty, nobody spoke, interrupted recording, low storage, export failed, delete and restore, Plus lapsed, kill and relaunch, launch recovery, not found, crash), plus loading, transitional moments and toasts.
coverage:
Read CLAUDE.md, packages/content/VOICE.md and BRAND.md, docs/brand/BRAND_SYSTEM.md (mark and gradient rules), docs/design (DESIGN_LANGUAGE, MOTION, BENCHMARK, COMPONENTS state and toast sections, CREATIVE drawing rules) and packages/design-tokens on origin/develop (4183844). Read the website on origin/main: Landing.tsx, the Aurora.tsx lamp aurora, NotFound.module.css (a night 404 with a 9% lamp radial), the hand-drawn drawings/*.tsx (Lamp, Window, Moon, Envelope, Page, Bed, ReadingLamp, Shoes), site.ts (the 'Filed in Month 9' chip) and ProofLetter. Main also carries tokens.atmosphere (lamp #F3C98B, lampGold, lampRose, lampDusk) from 6d9b382, which develop does not have yet. Journey record: origin/chore/journey-refresh (b7afe42) in /tmp/journey-refresh-qe. I read INDEX.md and all 147 steps/*.json, and looked at screenshots for every distinct screen group (about 75 PNGs, including the full captures J01-16, J03-03, J03-06, J06-01, J16-05 and J17-02). Copy sources read: strings.en.ts, and features/speech, language, packs, player, export, words, reminders and billing. Code read to see what each unhappy state really does: app/listen.tsx, app/review.tsx (WordsStatus, save failure, empty take), app/letter/[id].tsx (deleted, not found, WaitingCard), app/(tabs)/index.tsx (draft card), settings/recently-deleted.tsx, settings/export.tsx, settings/plus.tsx, components/child/plus-gate.tsx, components/resilience/*, app/+not-found.tsx, components/gate/age-gate-screen.tsx, ui/state-screen.logic.ts, ui/toast.tsx, ui/line-art.tsx, lib/capabilities.ts and app.config.ts. Not observed (native only, judged from code): phone-call and Siri interruptions, a kill mid-recording and the launch sweep, transcription failure, nobody spoke in Review, the language-pack wait, low storage before recording, Plus grace, retry and lapsed, and StoreKit restore success. Primary sources checked on 15 Oct 2026 from the developer.apple.com HIG JSON: Loading, Progress indicators, Privacy, Onboarding, Launching, Feedback, Alerts and Writing, plus the Declared Age Range framework page. support.apple.com and dayoneapp.com did not resolve from this sandbox, so Apple app behaviours (Voice Memos, Notes, Photos, Mail) and the Day One, Overcast, Calm and Headspace patterns are marked unverified (memory or a search summary). Stale captures: the journey branch predates #118, so the usage-sharing sheet (J04-04) and the Privacy usage switch (J16-02) no longer show on develop. Legal: the age question comes from LEGAL-REQ-002 (docs/legal/ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENTS.md) and PRD-REQ-019 (docs/prd/PRD.md, K-07, D-026). The journey INDEX's 'A-REQ-030' is wrong: A-REQ-030 is 'Offline entry' (PRD.md requirement table, A-entry-and-auth.md). Defects found while checking, each cited in the screens below:
- Any failure to start recording shows the microphone-denied screen.
- A phone-call interruption ends the take and nothing says why.
- errors.storageLow is never used.
- Add a child still fills in today's birthday and shows the placeholder 'Their name' in its helper line.
- The twins signature error says 'Asha and Nila calls'.
- Erase now has no confirmation, and the capture shows a stale 'Letter restored.' toast after the letter was erased.
- The in-app 404 has no side gutter.
- The Review empty-take state says the recording is safe when the file is empty.
- Review's nobody-spoke title says 'No talking in this one', which the Book rule forbids.
- Tonight lists only the first draft.
principles: Say what happened, where it happened, and the one thing to do next: one primary action, at most one quiet escape, never a dead end (the under-18 stop screen is the only legal exception). Apple HIG Writing, 'display it as close to the problem as possible, avoid blame, and be clear about what someone can do to fix it' (verified, HIG JSON read 15 Oct 2026); HIG Alerts, 'only essential information and useful actions' (verified).

Name the real cause and never reuse a state for a different problem: microphone off, microphone busy, phone full and an empty take are four screens, not one. HIG Feedback, 'Show people when a command can't be carried out and help them understand why' (verified).

No explaining the buttons, no 'we' preambles, no reassurance padding: one true fact per screen, usually 'The recording is kept.', said once. HIG Alerts, 'If your alert text and button titles are clear, you don't need to explain what the buttons do' (verified); HIG Writing, 'Check each word to be sure it needs to be there' and interjections 'can sound insincere' (verified).

Waiting is never blank: show the thing being worked on (the take, its length, a play control), keep something alive, use determinate progress when the app has it, and let people leave without losing anything. HIG Loading, 'Show something as soon as possible' and 'Let people do other things while they wait' (verified); HIG Progress indicators, 'When possible, use a determinate progress indicator' and 'Keep progress indicators moving' (verified).

Undo for what can be undone, a confirm only for what cannot, with a specific verb. HIG Alerts, 'Avoid displaying alerts for common, undoable actions, even when they're destructive' and specific titles such as 'Erase' (verified); HIG Feedback, 'Warn people when they initiate a task that can cause data loss that's unexpected and irreversible' (verified); Day One Trash with Restore and an irreversible empty (unverified, dayoneapp.com guide seen only through a search summary).

A toast states the result that just happened, in that result's words, offers the next useful step (Undo, Open) and never outlives it or contradicts the screen. HIG Feedback, reserve confirmation for 'activities that are sufficiently important' (verified); Apple Mail's Undo bar (unverified, memory; already the reference in COMPONENTS 2.14).

After a kill, a crash or an interruption, put people back where they were and say plainly what was kept. HIG Launching, 'Restore the previous state when your app restarts so people can continue where they left off' (verified).

Unhappy states share the website's atmosphere instead of a generic icon in a beige disc: paper or night tone, one static lamp radial (the web 404's 9% lamp wash, tokens.atmosphere from main, pre-rendered per MOTION 7), one hand-drawn line drawing chosen for the moment (ported from apps/web drawings, drawn on over tokens.motion.drawMs), brand type from the embedded faces, controls opaque from frame 1, Reduce Motion as a 200 ms fade. Website 404 and hero on origin/main (verified in repo); Headspace and Calm, one living element in an empty screen (unverified, memory; also MOTION.md M11).

screens.screen: Age question (first launch, and again after a mistaken No)
screens.problem: The very first thing anyone sees is a bare legal question on blank paper: 'Are you 18 or older?' with the line 'We ask everyone the same question.' over two outline pills and a greyed 'Continue'. That line is the founder's example of an AI-sounding sentence: it explains why we ask, sounds defensive, and is a 'we' preamble. There is no brand, no drawing and no light, so the journey starts at a checkpoint rather than at a book.
screens.proposal: Option A (needs the PRD sentence amended, see legal note): Welcome comes first. 'Begin the book' opens the question as a medium-detent sheet over the welcome page (paper surface, grabber, no Close; answering is the only way on). Option B (no amendment): keep the gate as the first screen, but give it the welcome's atmosphere: a static open-envelope drawing above the title and the lamp radial wash behind. Both options: title 'Are you 18 or older?'; delete ageGate.body entirely (no body line); two equal pills 'Yes' and 'No', same style and width, nothing preselected. Keep 'Continue', disabled until one is chosen: one stray tap on No would stop a parent for 24 hours, and both answers pass through the same step, so it stays neutral. Invite links and any deep link still land here first: keep the gate in the root layout and render the welcome inside the gate component, not as a route. Motion: the sheet rises on motion.standard (about 0.40 s); Reduce Motion: 200 ms fade. Haptic: none until Continue (outcome only).
screens.benchmark: Apple HIG Onboarding: 'design a flow that's fast, fun, and optional' and 'Postpone nonessential setup flows' (verified). Apple Declared Age Range: the framework lets an app 'request that people share their age range' and returns a declaration (verified on the framework page; the page does not describe the system UI). Calm and Headspace open on a brand moment before any question (unverified, memory).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: The requirement is LEGAL-REQ-002 (ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENTS.md: asked before first use, 'presented neutrally (no pre-selected answer, no hint that one answer is right)', store only a boolean, a stop screen, a 24-hour anti-retry, Declared Age Range where required) and PRD-REQ-019 (PRD.md, K-07, D-026). It is not A-REQ-030: that id is 'Offline entry', so the journey INDEX J00-open is wrong. Option A meets LEGAL-REQ-002 AC1 (the question appears when the person takes the first action). But PRD-REQ-019 says 'Before any first-run screen', so the founder amends that sentence and counsel confirms (register s.6 Q6 is the open neutral-screen question); until then, ship Option B. Removing the body line keeps the question neutral: it never hinted at the answer. Separate gap: no DeclaredAgeRange call exists in apps/mobile on develop, and LEGAL-REQ-002 needs one for Texas Apple Accounts.

screens.screen: Under-18 stop screen (and the way back after 24 hours)
screens.problem: 'Thank you for telling us.' / 'Early Letters is currently for adults 18 and over.' / 'Nothing you entered has been kept.' Thanking someone for saying they are under 18 is stiff and form-like. 'Nothing you entered' refers to nothing, since only a Yes or No was given. After 24 hours a grey 'I answered by mistake' appears. Blank paper, with the text block mid-screen.
screens.proposal: Title (serif, centered): '{app} is currently for adults 18 and over.' No body line. After 24 hours only, one quiet button: 'I answered by mistake'. Visual: paper tone and a closed Envelope line drawing, static (no draw-on, no breath, no lamp glow), so it reads as calm rather than inviting. No haptic, no timer, no 'come back tomorrow'. This is the one screen allowed no next action, by law.
screens.benchmark: HIG Writing: 'If you can use fewer words, do so' (verified). FTC neutral age screen practice of not inviting a retry (unverified, memory).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: LEGAL-REQ-002 AC2 and AC3: a stop screen saying the app is currently for adults 18 and over, nothing stored except the gate state, closed for 24 hours. Keep 'currently' (PRD-REQ-019 wording). Dropping 'Nothing you entered has been kept' avoids a claim that is only partly true: the time of the No is stored (D-026).

screens.screen: Welcome
screens.problem: The first brand moment is flat next to the website: a small open-envelope drawing in a beige disc, pushed left. The name is typed in Literata, although BRAND_SYSTEM says the wordmark is artwork and never retyped. There is no lamp light and no motion. For anyone who has just come back through 'I answered by mistake', this is their second impression too.
screens.proposal: Keep the copy: 'The baby memory book you fill by talking.', 'A few words at a time, in your own voice. Kept for your child to read and hear for years.', 'Your first two letters are free.', and the button 'Begin the book' (which opens the age sheet in Option A). Layout: the small-cut lockup from registry context app.header at the top instead of typed text. The website's Lamp drawing sits centered, drawn on over 1200 ms, then its glow goes from 0 to 1 (the web Lamp 'glow' prop), with one static amber radial behind (atmosphere.lamp at 10%). The button is opaque from frame 1. Reduce Motion: the lamp is shown lit, with a 200 ms fade.
screens.benchmark: Website hero and lamp aurora on origin/main (apps/web/src/components/landing/Aurora.tsx and Landing.tsx, verified in repo). HIG Launching: a splash 'at the beginning of your onboarding flow' that 'communicates succinctly' (verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: BRAND_SYSTEM: the wordmark is never retyped, and a gradient never sits inside or behind the mark itself, so the lamp radial goes below the lockup, not around it.

screens.screen: The promise
screens.problem: Mishearing causes most of the later unhappy moments, yet it is set up in a second card titled 'We can mishear': 'Your words are kept as you said them. We can mishear, so read each letter and fix anything we got wrong.' It repeats the first paragraph and leads with 'we' twice.
screens.proposal: Keep the title 'Exactly as you said it.', the Word for word paragraph, the voice card and 'That sounds right'. Replace the second card with the title 'Names can come out wrong' and the body 'Read each letter before you keep it.' Icon: the existing check-badge, or a small pencil. No other change.
screens.benchmark: HIG Writing: 'Choose words that are easily understood' and 'If you can use fewer words, do so' (verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: Keeps the meaning of settings.help.mistakes (read before saving), which the in-app disclosures require; never says software improves words.

screens.screen: First run: who is this book for (name, birthday, due date, twins)
screens.problem: Validation is right in spirit: the reason is given in words above a disabled Continue. Rough edges: a future birthday reads 'A birthday is a day that has already come. Choose today or earlier.', which lectures before it helps. The helper 'We sort letters by Asha's month of age.' is a 'we' explanation and, with a 60-character name, shows the whole name twice on screen (J01-06). 'Born today' is a quiet text link far from the date row.
screens.proposal: Future birthday: 'Choose today or an earlier day.' Helper under the date: 'Letters are filed by {child}'s month of age.', or just 'by month of age.' while the name is empty or over 24 characters. Keep 'Add a name to continue.', 'A name can have up to 60 characters.', 'Choose {child}'s birthday to continue.', 'Choose the due date to continue.', 'Choose a due date from today up to ten months ahead.' and 'Fill in or remove this name to continue.' State design: the reason line sits directly above Continue in caution tone with an icon, cross-fades over 150 ms when it changes, and never shakes. 'Born today' becomes a chip beside the date control.
screens.benchmark: HIG Writing: 'That password is too short isn't as helpful as Choose a password with at least 8 characters' (verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: The no-default birthday (the INDEX J01-07 fix) must stay; never gender the child.

screens.screen: First run: what does {child} call you
screens.problem: For twins the title is right ('What do Asha and Nila call you?') but the reason line is not: 'Add what Asha and Nila calls you to continue.' (J03-02). A grammar slip on the screen that names the person feels careless.
screens.proposal: Add onboarding.signsAs.needSignsAsMany: 'Add what {child} call you to continue.', and choose it with the same rule as titleMany. Nothing else changes.
screens.benchmark: HIG Writing: be clear (verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: Copy rule: never gender the child; the plural follows the number of names, not pronouns.

screens.screen: Choose a language sheet
screens.problem: Clear: the native name sits over the English name, Arabic runs right to left, and a check marks the chosen row. The no-match line 'No language matches that. These are the languages letters can be spoken in for now.' says what is possible.
screens.proposal: Keep. Only make sure that choosing a language whose speech model is not on the phone shows its size in the row ('Downloads when chosen, 575 MB', the existing languageCopy.status.absent).
screens.benchmark: Apple Settings language list, native name with the English name beneath (unverified, memory).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: D-056: seven languages; never promise mixing them in one sentence.

screens.screen: The book is open, with the one-time speech download
screens.problem: The celebration page carries a 575 MB ask with its own filled 'Download on Wi-Fi' button stacked above the page's filled 'Write the first one', so two primaries fight (J01-16). After 'Not now' the card says 'Not now. Your voice is kept either way.' directly above 'You can do this later in Settings, Recordings. Your voice is always kept.', the same reassurance twice (J01-17). The drawing is the same generic page in a disc used for empty states.
screens.proposal: One primary: 'Write the first one' (56 pt, at the bottom). The download becomes a bordered card below the headline: title 'Get your words ready', body 'A one-time download of 575 MB, so your words are written down on this phone. It waits for Wi-Fi.' Inside the card: a bordered secondary 'Download on Wi-Fi' and a quiet 'Not now'. After a choice the card collapses (LinearTransition, 280 ms) to one line. Yes: 'Getting ready, 12%' with a thin determinate bar, or 'Waits for Wi-Fi'. Not now: 'Not now. It is in Settings, Recordings.' Low space: 'This phone needs 575 MB free first.', with no download button. Visual: the website Page drawing drawn on, with the Lamp switching on beside it, over the lamp radial. The size always comes from the phone's plan.
screens.benchmark: HIG Onboarding: 'Consider including enough media... to prevent people from having to wait for downloads' (verified). The app cannot bundle 575 MB, so the wait must never block the first letter. Overcast and Apple Podcasts show download state inline on the item (unverified, memory).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: D-087: nothing downloads until the person taps; keep that. The voice is kept either way (true, D-086); say it once.

screens.screen: Tonight (home), including the waiting-letter card after a close, a kill or a held letter
screens.problem: Every unfinished thing shows the same card, 'A letter is waiting to be read back.' / 'Read it back': a typed letter closed mid-sentence (J07-05, 'You were so sleepy and then'), a letter held at the Plus gate that was already read back (J06-15, J07-10), and a spoken take. Tonight lists only the first draft (listDrafts(childId)[0] in app/(tabs)/index.tsx), so after a kill and relaunch a second kept take is invisible. Being offline changes nothing here, which is right.
screens.proposal:
The card's copy depends on the state, with one action each:
- Spoken, words ready: 'A recording is ready to read back.', action 'Read it back'.
- Spoken, words still coming: 'Your recording is kept. Its words are on their way.', action 'Open'.
- Typed draft: 'You were partway through a letter.', action 'Pick it up', with the first words shown in the letter serif.
- Held for Plus: 'A letter is ready to keep.', action 'Keep it' (opens Review, then the gate).
- Recovered by the launch sweep after the app closed: 'A recording was kept when the app closed.', action 'Read it back'.
Show every draft as its own card, newest first, each with a dateline ('Tuesday evening, 0:42') and no totals. Cards enter with motion.enter at a 30 ms stagger; Speak and Type never move.
screens.benchmark: HIG Launching: 'Restore the previous state when your app restarts so people can continue where they left off' (verified). Apple Notes and Mail keep each draft as its own item (unverified, memory).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: No counts of gaps or pending items: cards, not numbers. A held letter's copy never names a price (D-083).

screens.screen: Not much today, kept (inline confirmation)
screens.problem: 'Kept. Rest well.' with Undo is shown under 'Good afternoon, Mama.' at 2 pm (J08-02). 'Rest well' assumes bedtime and reads like a scripted sign-off.
screens.proposal: 'A quiet day, kept.' with 'Undo' beside it (this matches book.quietDay.a11y). It sits inline in place of the link, with a success check icon and ink text (not green), and stays until Undo or until the person leaves Tonight. On Undo the line fades out over 160 ms and the 'Not much today' link fades back.
screens.benchmark: HIG Feedback: confirm small actions quietly, in context ('status information can be displayed passively', verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: D-084: a mark with no words; no guilt, no counting.

screens.screen: Usage-sharing sheet (v1.1 only)
screens.problem: Stale capture: on develop the sheet never appears, because capabilities.analytics is off in every eas.json profile (#118) and consent-ask.tsx returns null; the journey branch predates that merge. When it returns, 'Help us make it better?' is an 'us' ask.
screens.proposal: v1.0: nothing to show; regenerate the journey so J04-04, J04-05 and J16-02 match develop. For v1.1: title 'Share usage and crash reports?', body 'Which screens you open and when something breaks. Never your letters, recordings, photos or anyone's names.', equal buttons 'Don't share' and 'Share', and the footnote 'Change this any time in Settings, Privacy.'
screens.benchmark: HIG Privacy: request only when needed, no incentives (verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: LEGAL-REQ-003: opt-in with equal choices; the privacy rules keep content out of analytics.

screens.screen: Listening (recording, paused, offline, a long quiet stretch)
screens.problem: Offline, nothing changes, which is correct. 'Still here. Take your time.' after 8 s of quiet is kind. The gaps are in code. A phone call, Siri or an alarm ends the take through endTake('interruption'), and Review then says nothing about why. Only leaving the app gets a reason: 'The recording stopped when you left the app. Everything up to then is kept.' The one destructive control has a cute label, 'Let it go', with the alert 'Let this recording go? / It will be removed from this phone. / Keep it / Remove it'.
screens.proposal:
Review gets one honest line for every stop reason:
- Background: 'The recording stopped when you left the app. Everything before that is kept.'
- Interruption: 'The recording stopped for a call or alert. Everything before that is kept.'
- Swept after a close: 'The recording stopped when the app closed. Everything before that is kept.'
Discard: the link reads 'Discard'; the alert title is 'Discard this recording?', the body 'It is removed from this phone.', and the buttons 'Cancel' and a destructive 'Discard'. Transition to Review: the glow contracts (scale to 0.6, opacity to 0, motion.standard, 280 ms) while Review's card rises (y 8 to 0). The recordStop haptic still fires after the session ends, as now.
screens.benchmark: HIG Alerts: 'Always use Cancel to title a button that cancels the alert's action', and use specific verbs (verified). Voice Memos keeps the partial take after an interruption (unverified, memory).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: Never records in the background (LEGAL-REQ-011); audio is deleted only on this confirmed discard.

screens.screen: Microphone off (and the start failures that currently reuse it)
screens.problem: 'We can't hear you yet' / 'Allow the microphone in Settings to speak your letters. Or type instead.', with 'Type instead' and 'Open Settings' under a generic envelope. The body explains both buttons and opens with 'we'. Worse, in listen.tsx begin() any error from start() falls into setPhase('denied'). So a microphone held by a phone call, a refused audio session or a full phone all show 'allow the microphone in Settings', although permission is granted and Settings cannot help. errors.storageLow ('This phone is almost full') exists but is never used.
screens.proposal:
Three states, one primary each, in the lamp state layout:
- Permission denied: title 'The microphone is off', body 'Turn it on in Settings to speak your letters.', primary 'Type this one' (pencil; opens Write with the same prompt), quiet 'Open Settings'. When the person returns to the app with permission granted, go straight to Listening's idle state.
- Microphone busy (start threw while permission is granted): title 'The microphone is in use', body 'Finish the call, then try again.', primary 'Try again', quiet 'Type this one'.
- Phone full (free space below about 50 MB, checked before beginTake): title 'This phone is full', body 'Free some space to record.', primary 'Type this one', quiet 'Try again'. These strings replace errors.storageLow.
Drawings: the website Page with its pencil line for denied and full, the Window for busy; drawn on over 1200 ms, with no breath on errors.
screens.benchmark: HIG Writing: 'be clear about what someone can do to fix it' (verified). HIG Privacy: ask when the feature is used; people change access in Settings (verified). HIG Feedback: 'help them understand why' (verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: Equal doors (DESIGN_LANGUAGE principle 5): typing is an equal way to write, never a consolation.

screens.screen: Listen opened without a tap (link or restored route)
screens.problem: A separate error-style page: 'Ready when you are' / 'Nothing is recording yet. Tap Start when you want to speak.', with 'Start' and the same envelope as the error screens. The body explains the button, and the page does not look like the Listening room it is.
screens.proposal: Render Listening itself, idle: 'To {child}', the audience line 'Only you, until you add it to the book.', the red circle at rest with the 4 s idle breath (MOTION 5b), no clock, and one line under it: 'Tap the red circle and talk.' The circle is the start control (120 pt, accessibilityLabel 'Start recording'), with Close at the top right. The microphone is untouched until the tap.
screens.benchmark: HIG Writing: avoid explaining (verified). Voice Memos, where the idle screen is the record button itself (unverified, memory).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: Glossary term from BRAND.md: 'the red circle' ('Tap the red circle and talk').

screens.screen: Review while words are being written down (also offline, and a take finished at once)
screens.problem: A white card with a moon in a beige disc and 'Writing down what you said.', and nothing else: no length, no sense of time for a one-part letter, and no way on except Close. On web it never ends. A take ended a second after starting (J05-08) gets the same open-ended wait. Being offline changes nothing, which is correct.
screens.proposal: Show the take as an object: the dateline 'To Asha · Tuesday evening', the length '0:42' beside a play control (same as Hear it), and the website Lamp drawing, whose glow breathes from 0.6 to 1 over 4 s while it works (indeterminate), with the line 'Writing down what you said.' Multi-part letters keep the thin determinate bar with 'Part 2 of 3' (it exists). After 15 s with no progress, add one quiet button, 'Read it back later'. It closes Review while the queue carries on, and Tonight shows 'Your recording is kept. Its words are on their way.' Takes under 1.5 s go straight to the empty-take state. When words arrive, each finished part fades in (180 ms, MOTION 5c), never word by word and never with a cursor.
screens.benchmark: HIG Loading: 'Show something as soon as possible' and 'Let people do other things while they wait' (verified). HIG Progress indicators: 'When possible, use a determinate progress indicator' and 'If a process stalls... provide feedback' (verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: MOTION 5c: motion never suggests the machine is writing, so no typewriter effect. Words that arrive later are shown exactly as said and never fixed unread (D-086).

screens.screen: Review when words do not come (native only: transcription failed, empty take, no words in the recording)
screens.problem:
From review.tsx, three states:
- Failed: 'We could not write this one down' / 'The recording is safe on this phone. You can try again or type it.', with Try again, Type instead and a footer 'Keep the recording'. That is three actions, and the body explains them.
- Empty take (phase 'waiting', the file has no audio): the same 'The recording is safe on this phone' text, which is untrue.
- No words: 'No talking in this one' / 'The recording is kept just as it is. You can add words by typing them.', with Try again, Record again, Type it instead and the footer Keep the recording. That is four actions, and the title says nobody spoke, which the Book's own rule forbids (the take may hold a laugh or babble).
screens.proposal:
- Failed, retryable: title 'No words yet for this one', body 'The recording is kept.', primary 'Try again', quiet 'Keep the recording'.
- Failed because the file is missing: title 'The recording did not save', primary 'Type it instead'.
- Empty take: title 'Nothing was recorded', body 'The take ended before any sound came in.', primary 'Record again', quiet 'Type it instead'.
- No words: title 'No words in this one', body 'The recording is kept just as it is.', primary 'Keep the recording', quiet 'Write the words'. Drop Try again (same audio, same result) and Record again (a new letter belongs on Tonight).
Remove the duplicate footer whenever the state card carries the primary. Drawings: a closed Envelope (kept) for failed and no words, the Page for an empty take.
screens.benchmark: HIG Alerts: 'only essential information and useful actions' (verified). HIG Writing: never say what is not true, and be clear what to do (verified).
screens.legal_or_constitution_note: D-086 and VOICE 'The app's own words': the note never says nobody spoke, the recording is never touched, and the person, not the app, writes any words.

screens.screen: Review when the language is not on this phone yet (native only)
screens.problem: From WordsStatus: 'Your English words are on their way' / 'Your voice is kept now. The words will follow as soon as this phone is ready for English.', plus 'Getting ready when you are on Wi-Fi.', a quiet 'Use mobile data 575 MB', a quiet 'Type it instead' and the footer 'Keep my voice'. That is four controls, and two sentences that say the same thing.
screens.proposal: Not yet agreed to the download: title 'Get your English words ready', body 'A one-time download of 575 MB.', primary 'Download on Wi-Fi', quiet 'Keep the recording for now'. Downloading or waiting: title 'Your voice is kept', body 'The words follow once English is ready on this phone.', and one status line: 'Getting ready, 40%' with a determinate bar, 'Waits for Wi-Fi, 575 MB', or 'This phone needs 575 MB free first.' The footer primary is 'Keep the recording', with one quiet action only: 'Use mobile data' while waiting for Wi-Fi, otherwise 'Type it instead'. The Lamp drawing's glow tracks the real download fraction (determinate, not a loop).

Please try again.', placed away from the button, which keeps its old label.

On success the normal saved moment plays.

screens.screen: Saved moment (added to the book, kept private, the second free letter)
screens.problem: The high point of the journey reads as an empty screen. The letter card fades to near-invisible ink on blank paper with a green line, 'Added to Asha's book.' (J06-09) or 'Kept just for you.' (J07-07 shows the person's own words at about 20% ink). There is no month and no sense of where the letter went, and green text is a generic system signal.

Copy:
- In the book: 'Added to Asha's book.' with the chip 'Filed in Month 7'.
- Private: a chip with a lock, 'Kept just for you'.
- Recording only: 'Kept. The words will follow.'
- The second free letter keeps 'That was your second free letter.', muted beneath.
Text in ink, not success green. In the Book the new card arrives with the accentSoft wash (newMarkMs 1.6 s). Reduce Motion: the chip and line fade over 200 ms, and the bloom is shown static.

That is three sentences of reassurance, a 'we' title, a technical button label, and the same off-brand fonts as the crash screen.

Notes: nothing found, 'No files were found to copy.'; failed, 'The copy did not finish. Nothing was changed.' Use the brand faces and a static closed Envelope drawing, as on the crash screen.
